verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only an interactive playground for testing calls against API endpoints. Nothing says it runs against a separate sandbox or test environment isolated from production data, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit. No sandbox base URL, test credentials, or non-production mode is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Use the interactive playground next to each endpoint to test calls.
